OUR PROCESS

How We Work

Every project follows a rigorous process to guarantee an exceptional finish that respects tradition while meeting modern requirements.

01

Consultation

We discuss your project, your needs and your vision.

02

Evaluation

On-site visit and technical evaluation of surfaces.

03

Quote

Detailed proposal with estimation of costs and deadlines.

04

Preparation

Meticulous preparation of surfaces for optimal adhesion.

05

Application

Artisan application of Tadelakt in several layers.

06

Finishing

Polishing with black soap for perfect waterproofing.
